name: aws-lambda
description: Deploy to AWS Lambda with SAM behind the Lambda Web Adapter — one overlay for every language, built by ap-build; credentials from the connected account's deploy role, no keys; readiness checks before a deploy; CloudFormation stacks and functions as tools
author: actionplatform
needs: tool: aws, sam (bundled as Python packages when not on PATH)
env: AWS_REGION; credentials from role_arn (the connected account's deploy role, OIDC, no keys) or the AWS CLI chain (SSO, profile, instance role)
